title: Trailing globstar inside parentheses does not match
prompt: Our picomatch does not handle a '**' at the end of a parenthesized group. The pattern 'test(/utils/**)' should match 'test/utils' and 'test/utils/file' but not 'test', and 'test?(/utils/**)' should also match 'test' itself. With strictSlashes it must not match 'test/utils', and 'test(/utils/**)/file' must not match 'test/utils'. Please fix it.
